item.description:
SKEGNESS COACH TRIP

Sunday 7th June 2026

Back by popular demand! Our bi-annual day trip to Skegness for our members, friends and families.

Tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are very reasonably priced at just £15. Renal patients will get refunded on the day.

Coach departs Leicester General Hospital @8AM

Coach return Leaves Skegness @5PM

Tickets available now, call: 07702703882 or email: leiclkpa@gmail.com
